purpose: Block common overreach when translating empirical observations into bridge claims.

counterexamples.claim_blocked: Correlation between an observable and a formal object proves the bridge.
counterexamples.reason: Correlation alone does not establish a governed correspondence.
Bridge failure only changes bridge status; it does not rewrite the formal calculus.
Multiple competing bridge hypotheses may coexist until evidence discriminates between them.

non_claims: Does not promote any bridge to theorem status.
Does not collapse empirical evidence into proof.
